tokens.TITLE: Shane Boyer x Ray-Ban Meta: POV NYC
tokens.META_DESCRIPTION: Shane Boyer (@shaneboyerr) shoots New York hands-free with Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses. Inside the #RayBanMetaPartner films and why POV is the perfect fit.
tokens.KEYWORDS: Shane Boyer, shaneboyerr, Shane Boyer Ray-Ban Meta, Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses, RayBanMetaPartner, AI glasses, POV filmmaker, TikTok, New York creator, influencer marketing
tokens.HEADLINE_GOLD: films New York hands-free for Ray-Ban Meta.
tokens.DEK: Ray-Ban Meta's smart glasses record the world from exactly where your eyes are — which is the whole point of a Shane Boyer video. The @shaneboyerr x Ray-Ban Meta partnership is the rare brand fit where the product IS the format.
tokens.HERO_CAPTION: Shane Boyer shooting New York for Ray-Ban Meta. Courtesy @shaneboyerr / watch on TikTok.
tokens.STAT_FOOTNOTE: Follower figures verified July 2026 (TikTok @shaneboyerr, Instagram @shaneboyer_). Ray-Ban Meta films are Boyer's own #RayBanMetaPartner TikTok posts.
tokens.LEAD: Most creators have to bolt a brand onto their content. For Shane Boyer (@shaneboyerr) and Ray-Ban Meta, the brand IS the content — smart glasses that record from exactly where his eyes are, which is the entire premise of a Shane Boyer POV video. It's the cleanest kind of brand fit: the product doesn't interrupt the format, it becomes it.
tokens.BODY_1: Boyer built an audience of 2.5M+ on POV New York — the ledge, the subway platform, the golden-hour rooftop. Ray-Ban Meta hands him a camera he doesn't have to hold, so the frame gets even more first-person. When he says he's letting the glasses plan his day in the city, the ad reads as a genuinely useful demo, because it is one.
tokens.H2_1: When the product is the format
tokens.BODY_2: In his "letting my Ray-Ban Meta glasses plan my day in NYC" film, the AI features aren't a spec list — they're the plot. A second post, exploring NYC with the Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses, does what Boyer does best: point the frame at the city and let the mood carry it, this time with the camera literally on his face. Both are tagged #RayBanMetaPartner, and both feel like his own work.
tokens.PULLQUOTE: The glasses don't interrupt his format. They complete it.
tokens.PULLQUOTE_CITE: — The DGTL Influence view on Shane Boyer x Ray-Ban Meta
tokens.BODY_3: Because Boyer already owns first-person New York. Ray-Ban Meta didn't have to teach his audience a new behaviour — POV is what they came for. So a hands-free camera reads as an upgrade to the thing they love, not an ad break inside it. That's the difference between renting attention and earning it, and it's exactly what a creator-led brief is supposed to buy.
